text: 商务部副部长鄢东在国新办新闻发布会上表示，下半年，中国服务贸易发展还将迎来诸多利好。一是旅行服务潜力持续释放。国际展会、商务活动、入境旅游旺季叠加，旅行服务出口预计将延续高增长的态势。二是高附加值业态增长势头良好。数字平台服务、云服务、人工智能相关服务出海提速，电信计算机和信息服务、知识产权、文化娱乐等服务快速发展，带动服务贸易向价值链的高端攀升。三是政策红利持续加持。服务业扩能提质、国家服务贸易创新发展示范区建设等政策措施落地见效，与即将举办的服贸会相得益彰，将为服务贸易高水平开放和高质量发展营造更好的环境。展望全年，中国服务贸易总体将维持积极向好态势
text_en: Vice Minister of Commerce Yan Dong said at a State Council Information Office press conference that in the second half of the year, China's services trade development will face further tailwinds. First, the potential of travel services continues to be unleashed. With international exhibitions, business activities, and peak inbound tourism season overlapping, travel services exports are expected to maintain high growth. Second, high value-added business models are showing strong momentum. Digital platform services, cloud services, and AI-related services are accelerating their global expansion, while telecommunications, computer and information services, intellectual property, and cultural entertainment services are growing rapidly, driving services trade up the value chain. Third, policy dividends continue to accumulate. Measures such as service sector expansion and quality enhancement and the construction of national services trade innovation development demonstration zones are taking effect, complementing the upcoming China International Fair for Trade in Services, which will foster a better environment for high-level opening-up and high-quality development of services trade. Looking ahead to the full year, China's services trade is expected to maintain a positive trend overall.
